description: Machine-readable inventory of researched source candidates. Presence is not acquisition, rights approval, or a publication decision. The prose register remains the evidence narrative.

sources.title: BFP fire-station and logistical records
sources.notes: `FOI ACCESS CONFIRMED`. The 15 Oct 2025 FOI response links a Google Drive folder named “LOGISTICAL REPORT as of August 2025” and a Fire Stats folder. The response explicitly says volunteer brigade fire-station data was not held in the delivered material. The actual attachment scope/schema must be downloaded and inspected; the request was for Manila, so do not assume nationwide coverage.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Download the linked attachment through normal public access, inspect its geographic scope/fields, ask BFP about national completeness and refresh frequency.

sources.title: BIR revenue regions and revenue district offices
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED`. RAO is a current official office/jurisdiction list, not a full coordinate file. The image-only PDF was processed with local OCR; 128 RDO rows and 19 region headings are published with attribution. OCR text is not a substitute for the official document.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Keep OCR evidence and confidence; validate physical operating addresses against current BIR pages before adding address fields.

sources.title: BJMP jail facilities
sources.notes: `DISCOVERY ONLY`. No verified national public bulk list/schema in this pass. Sensitive security and capacity information may be restricted.
sources.next_action: **P2/conditional.** Verify a public facility-only directory; avoid operational/security details.

sources.title: DENR-BMB protected-area information system
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL PORTAL VERIFIED`. Dashboard warns current system data may not fully reflect actual/real-time conditions while updates and validation continue. Protected areas are geographic sites/areas, not individual public-facility points.
sources.next_action: **P2 / contextual geography.** Use to associate a facility/site with a protected area only when useful; do not count each protected-area polygon as a facility.

sources.title: BuCor correctional facilities
sources.notes: `DISCOVERY ONLY`. No verified reusable facility dataset in this pass. Security-sensitive attributes must be excluded.
sources.next_action: **P2/conditional.** Include only publicly acknowledged locations and safe fields.

sources.title: CAAP area centres and aerodromes
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. Area-centre page was indexed with airport names; direct page access may be restricted to some clients. Not a downloadable national API. CAAP regulatory oversight does not prove CAAP owns/operates every airport.
sources.next_action: **P1/P2.** Acquire current aerodrome directory/AIP or authorized list; verify operator/owner, identifier, coordinates and active status airport by airport.

sources.title: CHED HEIDA higher-education institution directory
sources.notes: `ACQUIRED AND PUBLISHED`. Public server-rendered directory read on 15 Nov 2026: 18 regional directories, 280 pages, 2,716 rows, 2,711 unique after duplicate rejection. No login/CAPTCHA/prohibition encountered. Institutional fields published under `PUBLICLY_AVAILABLE_VERIFIED`; contact details and head names discarded; 123 `Others`/CHED-supervised/unrecognised rows remain internal; no coordinates or PSGC codes.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Seek a campus-level or complete export; retain regional-directory scope and `NATIONAL_PARTIAL` coverage.

sources.title: MGB geohazard layers
sources.notes: `DISCOVERY/CATALOGUE TARGET`. Do not assume all layers have downloadable national coverage or permissive terms.
sources.next_action: **P2 / enrichment.** Verify each layer, source date, CRS, spatial coverage and reuse terms.

sources.title: Basic education school masterlist and related EBEIS datasets
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. DepEd publishes downloadable data families, but its file acquisition has a human download/terms or feedback flow. Do not assume an official API. Earlier source page listed enrollment through SY2024–25 and several characteristics files at SY2023–24; recheck latest release.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Obtain original official files, inspect exact workbooks/sheets/headers, save the accepted terms and reference period, then automate parsing and any permitted future download.

sources.title: Barangay hall locations and LGU asset inventories
sources.notes: `FOI LIMITATION CONFIRMED`. The Masterlist of Barangays is a barangay reference, not a hall inventory. No nationwide hall-address/coordinate file was verified.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Use barangay list only for geography. Acquire halls from LGU asset inventories, NAMRIA if a specific layer exists, or official LGU directories.

sources.title: DILG-NCR DRRM-PULSE participating-LGU facility map
sources.notes: `PUBLIC FEED INSPECTED — NOT USABLE FOR BULK INGEST`. The map states that only DILG-validated records are shown and the portal lists participating LGUs, but `/api/facilities.geojson` returned exactly one feature (Marikina Rescue 161 / MCDRRMO Command Center, with exact coordinates) regardless of query parameters; `/api/map-layers.geojson` returned an empty collection. Coverage is participating LGUs, not nationwide, and emergency coordinates require security review.
sources.next_action: **BLOCKED pending broader validated export and written terms.** Ask DILG-NCR for an authorized export/API; do not infer a national inventory or publish operational coordinates without security review. Evidence: `docs/03-SOURCE-REGISTER.md` §6A.

sources.title: DILG-NCR evacuation-centre FOI list
sources.notes: `FOI ACCESS CONFIRMED`, but only NCR scope. DILG said detailed nationwide information was held by OCD/NDRRMC; subsequent OCD FOI response in Feb 2026 said the requested list was not available at OCD and referred requester to DILG/LGUs. Custodian referrals are inconsistent.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Obtain the NCR attachment and investigate individual LGU inventories. Record the inconsistent national custodianship; do not claim a national complete register.

sources.title: Public markets held by LGUs
sources.notes: `FOI LIMITATION CONFIRMED`. DILG says it does not maintain the requested national market list and recommends asking concerned LGUs. LGU201 is a contact/discovery directory, not the market dataset itself.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Build LGU-specific source connectors and requests; do not create a fake central DILG market dataset.

sources.title: DILG Subaybayan LIME 20 evacuation-centre project records
sources.notes: `FOI ACCESS CONFIRMED` for a project-data route. The response is about evacuation-centre projects, not a complete census of all existing evacuation sites. A separate DILG response says it does not maintain a consolidated master file in the requested format and says coordinates/PSGC are not held at that office. Direct portal fetch returned 403 in this research pass. Do not conflate completed project status with current facility operation.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Test access in normal browser, inspect actual project rows/fields and download capability. Use only as project/asset evidence, not the sole evacuation-centre register.

sources.title: DOH/HFSRB licensed health facilities
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL DIRECTORY VERIFIED`; exact current downloadable file and schema must be checked per page/release. A license is not the same as operational availability or PhilHealth accreditation.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Inspect current lists and connect only on verified identity.

sources.title: National Health Facility Registry
sources.notes: `FOI ACCESS CONFIRMED` and prior `ACCESS_BLOCKED`. DOH FOI disclosures in 2025/2026 describe CSV/Excel and shapefile releases. The public export returned 403 in prior tests. DOH disclosed missing coordinates, barangay centroids, map-derived coordinates, and incomplete registry coverage. Certain releases use a signed Data Release and Use Agreement.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Recheck permitted browser export; obtain current official file via authorized route/FOI; review exact agreement before public use; preserve coordinate provenance.

sources.title: DPWH infrastructure and public-building project records
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL PORTAL VERIFIED`. Project records are not a facility masterlist and do not prove the facility exists/operates today. Use to connect a project to a physical facility only with identity evidence.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Inspect current project fields/download access; preserve project-vs-facility distinction.

sources.title: DPWH national government-owned building inventory process
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED` for the order/forms. It establishes a standardized inventory process but is not proof of a public downloadable nationwide inventory.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Request the resulting inventory or an authorized/redacted export; identify the actual building-owning agencies.

sources.title: Local DRRM offices, command centres, and resources
sources.notes: Participating-LGU and validated-data limitations apply. Resource inventory is not automatically a public facility record.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Import public facility subset; do not expose sensitive equipment/resource details without review.

sources.title: DSWD centres, residential care facilities, and Standards Bureau lists
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. DSWD Standards Bureau lists dated files, including CRCF and LGU-accredited CRCF directories as of 24 Sep 2026. The public website may be dynamic and not provide a documented API. Separate DSWD-owned/operated, LGU-owned/accredited, and private entities. 76 facilities are `PUBLISHED` with attribution; only institutional name, field office, and postal address are exposed.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Acquire dated directories; inspect actual files; do not count private/merely accredited providers as government-owned.

sources.title: DTI Negosyo Center directory
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. On 15 November 2026 the endpoints returned 1,427 unique active center records across all 17 regions. The finder does not state ownership, operator, host, hours, public-access conditions or coordinates. Centers are often co-located in city halls, SUCs or partner premises; a center is a government service unit, not proof about the host building. Phone/email are withheld from the public record.
sources.next_action: **DONE (directory subset).** Published with attribution and takedown-on-notice; do not infer coordinates, host ownership, operator or current operation. Verify each center's host/operator only from an additional official source.

sources.title: DTI shared service facilities
sources.notes: `CATALOGUE CANDIDATE`. Verify whether each is government-owned, DTI-funded, LGU-hosted, cooperative- or privately operated. Funding support alone does not make it government-owned.
sources.next_action: **P2.** Include qualifying public-service facility records regardless of owner/operator when the source establishes the site and public-interest role; funding/ownership/operator must remain separate. A DTI-funded private/cooperative facility is not automatically government-owned.

sources.title: ECCD Council national child development centres and CDC resources
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED` for the 2023 NCDC list and official forms; `OFFICIAL PORTAL/REPORT VERIFIED` for 2025 NCDC count and a screenshot of the ECCD MIS list interface (Province, City/Municipality, Address, Status). The complete CDC registry is not proven as a public export/API. CDCs can be public, private, LGU, NGO or workplace-based; ownership must be distinguished.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Acquire NCDC list first; contact ECCD Council/DSWD/LGUs for permitted CDC registry. Do not interpret 1,057 NCDCs as the total number of all CDCs.

sources.title: DENR-EMB ambient air-quality monitoring stations
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. Pages are region-specific and some live/download links exist. A complete nationwide station inventory and coordinate export were not verified. A monitoring station is a public/environmental asset, not necessarily a public walk-in facility.
sources.next_action: **P2.** Collect station metadata and coordinates if officially available; store station as a monitoring/asset subtype; keep sensor observations in a separate related dataset.

sources.title: Philippine Geoportal facility layers
sources.notes: `CATALOGUE CANDIDATE`. Geoportal is a discovery/catalogue/map service. Its guide says only layers enabled in the Download window can be downloaded; otherwise contact the data owner. The inventory identifies layer-specific metadata/restrictions. Several layers are clearly old (e.g. 2003). A visible map layer is not automatically a current data file or reuse licence.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Review the current inventory row by row; create one source entry per selected layer; obtain original metadata, date, owner, geometry, CRS, download permission and redistribution terms. Do not ingest stale/unknown layers as current truth.

sources.title: LGU Section 524 community-facility inventory
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL LAW VERIFIED`; `NO CENTRAL DATASET VERIFIED`. The law does not itself create a centralized open database or prove that every LGU has published a digitized inventory.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Ask LGUs for their actual existing inventories and previous releases; capture responsible office, format, scope, date and rights.

sources.title: LGU public-market and slaughterhouse directories
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY EXAMPLE VERIFIED`; not a national source. DILG FOI says market records are at LGU level.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Use as a connector pattern, not a nationwide dataset. Search LGU domains systematically.

sources.title: National Museum regional, area, and site museums
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. Current official page exposes the location list and individual museum links. No national bulk API/export verified. Institutional museum fields are published with attribution; this is a directory subset, not all Philippine museums.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Maintain an official-link-backed directory from individual museum pages; verify address, operator, open/closed status and dates.

sources.title: NHA MAPS project, landholding, and occupancy layers
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL PORTAL VERIFIED`. Actual map portal sections were visible. Layer-specific records, downloads and rights still require inspection. Many records are project/land/occupancy sites, not facility identities.
sources.next_action: **P2.** Use as project/site/context source; do not turn parcels or all NHA project polygons into point facilities without evidence.

sources.title: NHA WFS DOH health-facility layer
sources.notes: Public WFS GetFeature returned 3 sampled features from a layer reporting 31,016 total features on 15 Nov 2026. Fields include fac_code, fac_name, fac_type, ownershp, region/province/municipality/barangay names and PSGC-style codes, latitude/longitude and prec_latlo. The layer appears derived from DOH data; ownership values, duplicate risk against existing health records, and redistribution rights are not yet established.
sources.next_action: Compare identities and ownership/type distributions against the canonical health registry; obtain written rights/derivation evidence before any publish or enrichment decision.

sources.title: NLP integrated directory of public libraries
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED`. January 2025 PDF was directly inspected. December 2025 official PDF is identified at the linked URL. Institution-level fields are published with attribution; librarian names and personal contact details stay private.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Acquire the latest official PDF, parse tables, compare releases, and keep personal-data minimization in the publication field list.

sources.title: NMIS NARIS accredited meat establishments
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED` and `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED` for the dated slaughterhouse list. This is an accreditation/licensing registry of establishments, many private. Eligible facility-level records may qualify as `PRIVATE_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PROVIDER`; they are not government-owned merely because NMIS licenses them. 357 establishments are `PUBLISHED` with attribution using factual establishment fields only; the page currently returns a WAF/TLS failure, so the verified 15 November 2026 artifact is the release of record.
sources.next_action: **P2 / regulated-provider candidate.** Assess facility-level identity and public-interest use case. Classify qualifying private establishments as `PRIVATE_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PROVIDER`; keep private counts distinct from government facilities.

sources.title: OCD/NDRRMC evacuation-centre inventory
sources.notes: `FOI LIMITATION / ROUTING CONFLICT`. OCD's Feb 2026 FOI response said it did not have the requested updated list and referred requester to DILG and LGUs. DILG has project-type evacuation-centre records on Subaybayan and limited NCR lists. No complete nationwide masterlist was verified.
sources.next_action: **P0.** Combine only independently sourced LGU and DILG project records with clear source type; request current authoritative scope from LGUs.

sources.title: PAGASA climate grids
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL PORTAL VERIFIED` in prior research. Download may require request/affiliation/purpose and acceptance of terms. Not a facility register.
sources.next_action: **P2 / enrichment.** Preserve grid release, resolution, baseline and scenario.

sources.title: PFDA regional and municipal fish ports
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED` for source descriptions and named regional fish ports; not a current complete geospatial masterlist. Municipal fish-port status/ownership changes on turnover.
sources.next_action: **P1/P2.** Request PFDA current inventory with port ID, status, coordinates, owner/operator and turnover date.

sources.title: PhilHealth accredited healthcare provider directories
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED`. The 30 Sep 2026 hospital PDF was parsed locally in prior project work (75 pages, 1,934 rows). The public site disclaimer permits use/reproduction for educational or informative purposes; 25 provider-category releases are published with attribution. The acquired Antenatal release remains blocked pending a validated re-ingestion. Category accreditation is not real-time service availability.
sources.next_action: **P0/P1.** Reuse existing parser; inspect every category separately; keep personal contact fields out of the public record; match to DOH with evidence and confidence.

sources.title: PHIVOLCS hazard layers
sources.notes: `OFFICIAL MAP/PORTAL DISCOVERED`. Source layers, download routes and reuse restrictions must be checked individually. Not a facility register.
sources.next_action: **P2 / enrichment.** Do not put hazard layers into the core facility entity table.

sources.title: PHLPost post offices and service locations
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. Public records are visible in page text. No formal public API/bulk download was identified. The page carries a copyright/all-rights-reserved notice; the recorded product decision publishes 1,272 factual locator facilities with attribution and takedown-on-notice. An earlier review-required release is retained internally.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Preserve service-location type and host/owner distinction; record the notice and keep expressive page content out of the public record.

sources.title: PNP police stations and precincts
sources.notes: `CATALOGUE CANDIDATE` only for the Geoportal Police precinct/station layer. A verified nationwide PNP bulk directory/API was not found in this research pass. Third-party police directories are not source-of-record.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Request the official station list from PNP/DIDM or regional offices; ask for permitted public fields and exclude sensitive operational information.

sources.title: PPA list of ports covered in PPA statistics
sources.notes: `FILE/DOCUMENT VERIFIED` and `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. The 22-page PDF was acquired on 15 November 2026 and parsed into 574 rows: 54 base ports, 94 TMO/OTP entries, 155 other government ports and 271 private ports. PPA-managed base ports and TMO/OTP entries are classified as government facilities, other government ports keep an unspecified owner, and private ports are private public-service providers with no inferred owner/operator. Blank RORO/NON-RORO marks remain unknown. The separate MICT note is retained as evidence and not ingested because its hierarchy and ownership are not stated.
sources.next_action: **DONE (directory subset).** Published with attribution; verify coordinates, berth capacity, public access and current operator only from additional official sources. Do not treat the list as a census of every port or landing place.

sources.title: PRC regional offices, satellite offices, and offsite service centres
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED`. The interactive location map enumerates many service centres, including mall/LGU-hosted points. These are PRC-operated service locations, not necessarily PRC-owned real estate. No public API verified.
sources.next_action: **P1.** Inspect current map/detail pages and data payload; preserve facility-vs-host location distinction and opening-hour freshness.

sources.title: TESDA registered TVIs and assessment centres
sources.notes: `DIRECTORY CONTENT VERIFIED` for searchable public directory and statistics. National bulk export/public API and exact provider-level schema remain unverified. Aggregate provincial counts are not provider records.
